_help: PLACEHOLDER HOURS, edit me. All times are Ottawa time (24h). 'windows' apply every day. 'weekly' overrides one weekday (0 = Sunday ... 6 = Saturday), use [] for a day off. When you confirm a booking by email, copy its 'slot-ottawa' value from the Netlify form email (like 2026-11-19 18:20) into 'blockedSlots' so nobody else can pick it. 'blockedDates' takes whole days (2026-12-25). Keep the commas right, or the page shows an error.
